# Regional daily study (generated by `scripts/run_daily_regional_study.py`)

Git commit `1b5239ea4e`. Zenodo state-level daily energy met (MU); validation 2021-2022; the test period was not loaded. Target in every model: ratio to the same-weekday anchor. MAE in MU, MAPE and WAPE in %. Paired intervals: 95% moving-block bootstrap, block 28 days.

## Horizon 1 day

Samples: train 2,119, validation 603. Direct XGBoost best of 20 trials (validation MAE 49.7 MU); ridge alpha 0.1.

| Validation model | MAE (MU) | MAPE % | WAPE % |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| naive | 141.1 | 3.63 | 3.59 |
| ridge | 52.1 | 1.35 | 1.33 |
| xgb_direct | 49.9 | 1.29 | 1.27 |
| xgb_bottom_up | 45.3 | 1.17 | 1.15 |

## Horizon 7 days

Samples: train 2,130, validation 611. Direct XGBoost best of 20 trials (validation MAE 131.2 MU); ridge alpha 10.

| Validation model | MAE (MU) | MAPE % | WAPE % |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| naive | 140.3 | 3.60 | 3.56 |
| ridge | 136.1 | 3.49 | 3.45 |
